title: Meta Muse Wonder remembers you
style: aurora dark midnight green, lime accent, sleek fast news

lines: Meta just launched an AI built to *remember you*.
It is called *Muse Wonder*. Meta says its *Active Memory* carries what matters across your chats, so you stop *starting from scratch*.
Then there is *Active Focus*. When it hits a wall, it tries *another approach*, and checks in before *important actions*.
Meta says it can *compete* with the latest models from *OpenAI* and *Anthropic* on some benchmarks.
Those are Meta's own numbers, so independent tests are *still to come*.
Would you want an AI that *remembers you*? Follow for more.

meta.topic: Meta Muse Wonder launch with Active Memory and Active Focus

facts.claim: Meta launched new models called Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full
Meta says Active Memory carries important information across conversations and retrieves it when relevant, so users do not start from scratch
Meta says Active Focus keeps working on hard tasks, tries alternative approaches and checks in before important actions
Meta says the models compete with the latest OpenAI and Anthropic models on some benchmarks
The benchmark results are Meta's own; independent testing has not confirmed them yet
